Definition: an (unfortunate) occurrence, i.e. some accidental (ceremonial) disqualification
BiblicalUsage: The word means a chance happening, and its one use is the law of the camp: if there be among you any man, that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night, then shall he go abroad out of the camp.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the law as God's care for a holy camp, where even an accident is dealt with honestly.
